about.title: About Me
about.heroSubheading: building scalable products across frontend, backend, and API architecture
about.paragraph1: Senior frontend and mobile engineer with hands-on full-stack architecture experience. I started coding in 2001 and have built my career around modern JavaScript ecosystems, with deep expertise in React and React Native and a growing focus on API design, backend systems, and scalable product delivery.
about.paragraph2: After working as a Frontend Developer at InterCloud, I moved into entrepreneurship and am currently building two initiatives: Vue d'Esprit, a digital studio delivering web and product solutions, and Kaast, a media communication platform designed for internal company collaboration and engagement, already used by multiple clients.
about.paragraph3: Across products such as Synqit, Soulbm, ASBA, and Kaast, I have designed backend architecture, defined API structures, modeled data relationships, and set up maintainable infrastructure alongside the frontend experiences. I work with Node.js services, Strapi, SQL/PostgreSQL, Prisma, Sequelize, and Docker to build systems that stay clear, practical, and maintainable as they grow.
about.hardSkillsIntro: Core technologies and delivery capabilities I use to design interfaces, define APIs, model data, and ship complete products from user flows to backend architecture.
about.softSkillsIntro: How I collaborate, prioritize, and drive product delivery in real-world contexts.

about.paragraph4: For the past two years, I have also served as President of the kids nonprofit association Le Sou des Ecoles de La Bâtie Montgascon. We organize 7 events each school year, helping generate a budget of over €900 per classroom to support school trips and other activities for the children.

synqit.title: Founder & Product Engineer
synqit.summary: Collaborative playlist platform for events and cross-service sharing between Spotify and Apple Music through a single magic link.
synqit.point1: Designed the full-stack architecture across host dashboards, guest flows, playlist moderation, and third-party music integrations.
synqit.point2: Defined the API structure and event data model for no-signup guest submissions, live moderation, event closing, and guest-link management.
synqit.point3: Built the frontend product experience in parallel with the backend logic that powers playlist import and cross-service sharing.
